questions.question: How does demand paging improve memory efficiency in virtual memory systems, and what triggers a page fault?
questions.answer: Pages load only when accessed via page faults, avoiding unnecessary memory allocation and improving system performance.
questions.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A[Process accesses memory] --> B{Page in RAM?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Access data directly]
    B -->|No| D[Page fault triggered]
    D --> E[OS handles fault]
    E --> F[Load page from disk]
    F --> G[Update page table]
    G --> H[Restart instruction]
    H --> C
